paragraphs.text: Kinetics were fitted with the pseudo-second-order (PSO) model; the GO used here was graphene oxide from a supplier. X-Ray Diffraction (XRD) confirmed the phase.
Composite C1 denotes our iron-doped carbon. Isotherms were described by Langmuir isotherms. J. Smith analysed the data.
Composite C1 adsorbed 45 mg/g of methylene blue, which may reflect its smaller pores. We compare with reduced graphene oxide (rGO).
